title: Coefficient naturality of the concrete module/Ext resolution equivalence
statement: For any scheme X, nonnegative degree q, modules F and G and coefficient morphism phi:F -> G, the explicitly constructed moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv from module-derived sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology] to H [pqf-def-cohomology] commutes with their maps on phi. The equivalence is the composite of the standard module injective-resolution comparison, exact forgetting of homology, the inverse acyclic-resolution comparison on the forgotten resolution, the inverse concrete Ext/derived-sections comparison obtained from Hom complexes and the section adjunction, and Ext precomposition by the inverse free-abelian-terminal/constant-integers source isomorphism. All these maps are constructed; no arbitrary natural equivalence is chosen.

source.place: Tag 03FD, Lemma 21.12.4; Tag 01FT (derived sections); Tag 06XR (Ext by injective resolutions)

proof.text: Construct the explicit Ext/derived-sections natural isomorphism from Hom complexes and the section adjunction. Its domain is the fixed free-sheaf Ext functor, definitionally the evaluated cohomology functor. Cache the existing sheafification and Ext-size proofs for the scheme site. The constant-source Ext functor is definitionally Mathlib Sheaf.functorH; no new comparison map is chosen.

Forgotten injective modules are acyclic for abelian sections. The explicit Ext/section comparison transports this vanishing to rightAcyclic, so the forgotten module resolution computes derived abelian sections. Compose its acyclic-resolution comparison with exact forgetting of the module section homology and the terminal Ext-source isomorphism to construct E.

Package the common-resolution coefficient square as resolutionSectionsNatIso: lift coefficient maps between standard resolutions, apply injective-resolution naturality and exact-forgetting homology naturality, then acyclicComparison_naturality. Compose three abstract natural isomorphisms with sectionsComparisonNatIso before scheme specialization: the common-resolution section map, inverse Ext/section map, and original precompAddEquiv.symm of the terminal-source isomorphism. The latter is extSourceNatIso, natural by Mathlib Ext associativity. Retain the adopted source construction's identity factors for the definitionally equal cohomology functors. The existing source extension supplies its cache and packaging API; consumers import the adopted source owner and extension. Convert the resulting component to an additive equivalence and evaluate its natural square. All component functions and inverses remain the original resolution-normalized maps.

proof_origin.place: Reuse the adopted source common-resolution construction, including its identity natural isomorphisms. The consumer migration to the existing source owner and extension is already reviewed and landed. F2 retires the remaining duplicate Sheaf module; neither the source library nor any consumer source file is edited. The coefficient square and normalization APIs are unchanged.
